people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”
translations.bsb: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us this well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock?”
translations.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
translations.asv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his sons, and his cattle?
